base: Accepted X04 R3 frozen sources plus only six simulation-file changes. No Git commit.

logic.normalization: Controlled fixtures set identical run UUID inputs before actions (including future settlement/drop receipts). Snapshot labels only run.runId, account.run.id and support.stageReceipt prefix; all other selected run fields, statuses, specials, visual/attack events, account and equipment combat state compared exactly.

cpu.method: Production functions, paired independent Worlds in one Node process; alternate order across twelve pairs, warm five calls, counter probes outside timed loops. Cast benchmarks include clearing their emitted transient arrays and resetting source energy/cooldown. Carrier dt=0 maintains current state; neither browser rendering nor overall FPS.

controls.decision: C25 retains existing per-missile live-target snapshots. Damage can change live membership between missiles; no across-missile roster cache selected. Control replay proves unchanged hit order, dead-target handling and state, not a performance improvement.

visualReview.result: Seven image pairs reviewed. No obvious missing, black, misplaced or unreasonable effect changes. Primary two battle differences retained; two fixed-history rechecks RGB-exact.

browser.history: Primary live intervals advanced differently; later retained AcidSalivaWeapon:2 pool capacities were 128 versus 64 while active output was exact. Fixed-only recheck has exact resource records and pixels. This establishes reproducibility with controlled history, not the precise cause of each primary pixel difference.
browser.fpsConclusion: All five primary frozen-low samples were slower in the candidate. No overall frame-rate gain demonstrated or attribution established; preserve all timing samples.

decisions.result: Per-cast density counted once; direct maximum with ID tie-break; zero/one candidate avoids pair work.
Single-pass boss heal/target selection retains eligibility and ID ties; retries every original eligible tick. Empty target scan remains, and its small CPU regression is retained.
Boss/lord Lurker uses its original timed mode cycle without the unused ordinary-near query.
Explicit special position skips unused connected-location enumeration; legal placement and RNG order retained.
One-call carrier/child roster reused through initialization and paid replacement; duplicate cleanup removed. Live public queries and reserve rank are recomputed, all stat refresh points retained.
Unresearched elite storm returns before target enumeration; feedback variant remains available and initial combat-state creation retained.
Hydralisk fan chooses each best angular target without sorting the full pool; primary packet, ID tie-break and five launch order retained.

C25 retains existing per-missile live-target snapshots. Damage can change live membership between missiles; no across-missile roster cache selected. Control replay proves unchanged hit order, dead-target handling and state, not a performance improvement.

limitations: CPU results are scoped production-function measurements in Node, not whole-game FPS.
Single-target storm and empty boss target search did not improve; no reduced scan frequency or gameplay delay introduced.
Cross-run browser timing includes environmental variance and probes; report all samples without attributing overall FPS gains.
Fixed same-seed diagnostic worlds and health-lock browser scenes do not replace natural campaign, physical input or human acceptance.
